services.desc: The PoCo Heritage Museum and Archives runs in-person educational programs for local schools! Our school tours are typically 1.5 hours in length but we can also offer different program lengths upon request. We run various programs for Grades K-12 (including ELL) and can tailor our programs to your needs or interests upon request. The PoCo Heritage Museum and Archives has turned its educational programs into online program activity booklets just for you.
